contract.precision: Original learned values preserved exactly; GGUF F16 matrices/F32 vectors; F16 KV caches in both engines; activations/logits/reductions differ, not identical FP16 arithmetic
contract.timing: Single unpadded sequence, all transformer layers/output offloaded, raw prompt/no inserted BOS, greedy selection with finite check, EOS ignored for fixed output lengths; first token excluded from decode count; context/KV allocated before warmup and reused with logical reset in BOTH engines. Not the fresh-KV-session Venturi CLI benchmark.
contract.exclusions: Loading/tokenization/context allocation/process startup/teacher-forced validation excluded from timing; resident memory samples include loading and untimed validation. llama tokenization is independently checked against exact prompt IDs.
contract.limitations: Tiny Pythia model only; no serving/network/batching, no Qwen/Q4/general engine superiority claim. Native llama-bench synthetic timings must not be mixed with these greedy timings.
